chapter_seo_title: Dao Gui Yi Xian Chapter 117: The Ao-Jing Sect’s Ruins – A God Without a Head
chapter_meta_description: Li Huowang journeys to find the Ao-Jing Sect, only to discover their temples in ruins and their god’s statue decapitated. What destroyed the keepers of the Thousand Greats Record?
og_title: A God Without Its Head: The Fall of the Ao-Jing Sect
og_description: Li Huowang’s hike to find a new ally turns into a ghost hunt as he finds only empty temples and a terrifying inscription.
twitter_title: The Ao-Jing Sect has fallen. Who—or what—did it?
twitter_description: Our boy found the first Temple of the Cross. It was empty. The second one had a beheaded god. Something is wrong.
